sources.title: shiranui_flare_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive]]'s [[Shiranui Flare]].

It consists of a blue [[detached collar]] with a [[red bowtie]], a [[skirt set]] consistsing of a [[white shirt|white]] [[criss-cross halter|criss-cross]] [[halter shirt]] with a [[cleavage cutout]], a [[cutout above navel]] and [[criss-cross back-straps]], and a [[white skirt|white]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[bow skirt|bow]] [[miniskirt]] with a [[large_bow|large]] [[back bow]], [[wide sleeves|wide]] [[white sleeves|white]] [[detached sleeves]],  [[white gloves|white]] [[half gloves]], [[white garter straps|white]] [[garter straps]] [[white thighhighs|thighhighs]] and [[blue footwear|blue shoes]].

[b]Note:[/b] Despite the name, this tag refers to her [i]current[/i] default costume, which she started using in December 12, 2021, and is her fourth chronologically. For the default costume she originally used when she first debuted, and the modified version she originally used for 3D streams, see [[Shiranui Flare (old design)]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #4975096
